summary: Lion Group Holding Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on August 24, 2026, attaching a press release reaffirming its long-term holding of approximately 195,000 Hyperliquid (HYPE) tokens, valued at about USD 15.8 million, as part of its digital-asset treasury strategy. The company stated it has not sold any HYPE tokens since establishing the position. No transaction, tender offer, merger, or other special-situation event is described; the filing merely discloses ongoing treasury holdings and market commentary. This is a routine current report with no deal terms, board actions, or structural mechanics, thus not a special situation.
